text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe we get to see Gimlet and 
Kris S go head-to-head in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) two years in a row! That's so 
hype~~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
“How should I put it, they really feel 
like destined rivals. From the same class, 
always competing against each other――”

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, geez! I can't wait to see the two 
of them face off! Do your best, both of 
youuuuu!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be that I...―― Even before being 
born into this world...――"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she had been yearning all along to 
compete against Kris S time and time 
again...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—The time has come. Let us be on our way, 
then.
choice_data_list: Go and overcome Symboli Kris S!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Sit and await the moment. The moment I 
descend as the "God of Destruction"—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing them side by side is quite a 
sight...! Gimlet!! Kris S!! Good luck to 
both of you!!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The tears just won't stop...! Why, God?! 
Just seeing the two of them side by side 
in the paddock, gazing at each other—!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Digitan...! Wishes for this spectacle to 
last forever...!! More intensely than ever 
before...!!!
